header.sub: Create a unique link for each patient. End-to-end encryption active in every session.

sched.sub: Patients who requested a slot via your public link. Approve to create the session and send email confirmation.
sched.confirmApprove: Approve this request? We'll create the session and email the patient.
sched.rejectPrompt: Want to provide a reason? (optional, logged in audit)

list.emptyBody: Every session you create here gets a unique link, end-to-end encrypted — just you and your patient.
list.ocultarTitle: Remove from list (kept in the patient record)
list.preNoteSavedTitle: Your pre-session note (saved in this browser only)
list.confirmedTitle: Patient clicked the confirmation link from the reminder email
list.confirmEncerrar: End this session? It will be marked as completed.
list.confirmOcultar: Remove this session from the list? The record stays in the patient chart — only hidden here.

modalNew.title: New session
modalNew.sub: Set the patient's name (a nickname works) and generate a unique link. The link expires in 2 hours — perfect to send just before the session.
modalNew.patientEmailHint: To send a confirmation now and a 24-hour reminder.
modalNew.patientPhoneHint: Receives confirmation and reminder via WhatsApp. Enable in Profile → WhatsApp.
modalNew.scheduledAtHint: Use to schedule ahead — you can still enter early.
modalNew.recurrenceHint: Creates N sessions at the same time, 7 days apart. Requires a set time.
modalNew.tissConvenioPlaceholder: — Select (patient must have a card on file) —
modalNew.tissHint: The TISS form is created after saving the session. Initial status: draft. Track in TISS → Forms.
modalNew.errPickPatient: Select a patient or enter a name.
modalNew.errRecurrenceTime: Set a time to repeat weekly.
modalNew.trialExpired: Your trial expired. You need an active plan to create sessions. Go to your profile now?

modalLink.title: Session link generated
modalLink.sub: Send this link directly to the patient. It expires in 2 hours and can be used only once.
modalLink.seriesSub: Series of {{n}} sessions created. This is the link for the 1st — grab the links for the rest from the schedule on the day.

preNote.title: Pre-session note
preNote.sub: Quick reminder for you to check before/during the session. Saved in this browser only — never sent to the server.
preNote.placeholder: e.g.: explore work topic · check sleep · follow up last exercise

recibo.title: Send receipt
recibo.sub: Creates the transaction in finances (paid status) + issues the receipt + sends it to the patient. You can resend later via the public link.
recibo.tussHint: Includes the TUSS code + CBO on the receipt. Insurance companies usually require this for reimbursement. Leave blank if private-pay.
recibo.waHint: WhatsApp requires an active config in Profile → WhatsApp. Otherwise, a public link is available for you to share manually.
recibo.noChannel: Select at least one delivery channel.
recibo.waNotEnabled: ⚠ WhatsApp not enabled (configure in Profile → WhatsApp)

nfse.title: NFS-e
nfse.desc: Issue an electronic Service Invoice (NFS-e) via NFE.io. NFE.io cost: ~R$ 0.15-0.40/invoice.
